capabilities: Render habit records as contribution grids
Log habits from Apple Reminders or Markdown
Track daily amounts and named items
Set goals, repeat rules, and challenges
extras: No network requests or telemetry; all data stays in Markdown files in the vault. The optional Mac sync installs a background job outside Obsidian that keeps waking every 5 minutes even after uninstall unless removed first. Not affiliated with Apple.
motivation: The author built it to log habits with Apple Reminders and visualize them in the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track habits or view them as a contribution grid over time.

relations.evidence: built to log habits with Apple Reminders and visualize them in your vault
completed reminders from an iOS Shortcut are read from a Markdown log file

summary: Habit tracker that renders Apple Reminders or Markdown habit records as a GitHub-style contribution grid with week views, goals, and challenges.
